lines.1: I opened the door to the rooftop.
lines.2: 「If Leo persuades her, that's three stamps without us lifting a finger.」
lines.3: The sea breeze whooshed past me.
lines.4: As always, the wind was strong up here.
lines.7: I cleared my throat and steadied my breathing.
lines.8: It was just the two of us. There was nothing to fear.
lines.9: Go. Press the attack. Show her the dignity of an upperclassman.
lines.11: I finally summoned the courage to speak.
lines.14: 「Um, I'm talking to you, Yashi... Miss Yashi.」
lines.17: 「I'm Leo Tsushima from Class 2-C. I'm the student council vice president.」
lines.18: 「I looked up your name on the roster.」
lines.20: I instinctively looked away for a moment.
lines.22: I almost pulled out my wallet on reflex.
lines.23: 「I-I came to ask if you might be willing to help out with the student council.」
lines.25: With that, she turned her back on me.
lines.26: How was I supposed to recruit her?
lines.27: For now, I needed to keep the conversation going and find some kind of opening.
lines.28: 「It feels good up here, doesn't it?」
lines.29: 「Do you come here often after school?」
lines.31: Come on. Don't let her intimidate you.
lines.32: 「I come up here sometimes too. Usually at lunch, though.」
lines.34: I never knew silence could hurt this much.
lines.35: Her hair stirred softly in the wind.
lines.38: 「Is it hard to take care of?」
lines.43: The force of her rejection was overwhelming.
lines.44: At least the fact that she used polite language showed she had some basic manners.
lines.45: If anything, that politeness only made the wall between us feel higher.
lines.48: 「That pathetic look on your face was a little funny, Senpai.」
lines.50: The rooftop door slammed shut behind her.
